title: operation-request
description: The Control Center-facing shape of a safe operation request (issue #91), carrying the RBAC/ABAC permission decision that AWCMS made BEFORE the request reaches OMES. `operation` is a closed enum limited to the read/lifecycle operations issue #91 exposes to tenant-scoped screens (status, preflight, start, stop, restart, update, backup, rollback) - a subset of `deployment.request`'s broader operation enum (which also allows `install`/`configure`/`restore` for direct job-runner use). additionalProperties=false everywhere means neither a free-form command nor a smuggled second tenant scope can ride along with this request.

permission.description: The RBAC/ABAC decision AWCMS made for this actor/operation/target BEFORE submitting the request. OMES does not trust `granted: true` on its own - the job runner (issue #90) re-derives its own allowlist/approval decision; this field exists so the request is self-describing and auditable end to end.
